scientific_integrity: Classical counting and partition asymptotic methods credited. Historical priority may be affected by unlocated subgroup-marked enumeration. No independent verification.
scientific_limitations: Jointly uniform ordered commuting permutations; two fixed linearly independent primitive word vectors; asymptotics hold for fixed determinant; exact finite identities hold for n>=1. Not a full first-order convergence theorem.
title: Determinant-controlled joint derangements of primitive words in commuting permutations
